official_quality_semantics_and_limits.CFE_note: When coordinates come from CFE, QUALITE_XY describes coherence between fiscal and Sirene addresses; it is not always an independently certified house-position accuracy measure. This qualifies the simple code-label interpretation in the preceding schema memo.
official_quality_semantics_and_limits.freshness: The statistical document describes monthly updates for commune changes and annual updates for within-commune address corrections. Point equality alone cannot certify freshness or the same real establishment/site.
official_quality_semantics_and_limits.distance_precision: Documented for random placement within a street/locality, not a universal posterior/radius for every point. Aggregate availability by code is retained in the sealed report; no candidate uncertainty repaired or assigned.
official_quality_semantics_and_limits.independence: RIL/fiscal/cadastre/BAN/CFE sources can contribute to statistical geocoding. August stock address source tags can indicateBAN/Cadastre. Neither the older quality stock nor exact/Q32coincidence proves BANindependence.
